requirement_text: The system shall allow a registered member to borrow a book.
ground_truth_issue_description: No handling for the case where the book is currently unavailable

requirement_text: The system shall allow a member to return a borrowed book.
ground_truth_issue_description: No handling for an overdue return (fine/penalty case)

requirement_text: When a member's borrowed book exceeds the due date the system shall notify the member.
ground_truth_issue_description: No handling for what happens if the member ignores the notification

requirement_text: The system shall allow an admin to add a new book to the catalog.
ground_truth_issue_description: No handling for a duplicate ISBN already in the catalog

requirement_text: The system shall allow a member to search for a book by title.
ground_truth_issue_description: No handling for a zero-result search

requirement_text: The system shall allow an admin to remove a book from the catalog.
ground_truth_issue_description: No handling for removing a book that is currently borrowed

requirement_text: The system shall allow a member to reserve a book that is currently unavailable.
ground_truth_issue_description: No handling for notifying the member once the book becomes available

requirement_text: The system shall allow a member to borrow a book only if the book is available and the member has no unpaid fines; otherwise the system shall display a rejection message.
ground_truth_issue_description: Edge case (unavailable/unpaid fines) already explicitly handled

requirement_text: The system shall allow an admin to add a new book to the catalog and if the ISBN already exists the system shall reject the addition and display an error message.
ground_truth_issue_description: Duplicate ISBN case already explicitly handled

requirement_text: The system shall allow a member to renew a borrowed book up to two times provided no other member has reserved it; otherwise the renewal request shall be denied.
ground_truth_issue_description: Renewal limit and reservation conflict already explicitly handled

requirement_text: The system shall provide a user-friendly interface for searching books.
ground_truth_issue_description: "User-friendly" is subjective and not measurable

requirement_text: The system shall process borrow requests quickly.
ground_truth_issue_description: "Quickly" has no measurable time bound

requirement_text: The system shall ensure the catalog is reasonably up to date.
ground_truth_issue_description: "Reasonably up to date" is subjective

requirement_text: The system shall handle a large number of concurrent users efficiently.
ground_truth_issue_description: "Large number" and "efficiently" are both unmeasurable

requirement_text: The system shall provide appropriate notifications to members.
ground_truth_issue_description: "Appropriate" does not specify notification type or timing

requirement_text: The system shall allow a member to borrow up to 5 books at a time.
ground_truth_issue_description: Measurable numeric limit already specified

requirement_text: The system shall send an overdue notification email within 24 hours of the due date passing.
ground_truth_issue_description: Measurable time bound already specified

requirement_text: The system shall support at least 200 concurrent user sessions without response time exceeding 2 seconds.
ground_truth_issue_description: Measurable performance criteria already specified

requirement_text: The system shall secure member data properly.
ground_truth_issue_description: "Properly" does not specify a security standard or mechanism

requirement_text: The system shall allow an admin to generate a report listing all books overdue by more than 7 days.
ground_truth_issue_description: Measurable threshold already specified
